question: Does independent source-rate fluctuation alone identify source delay and gain, and can source-conditioned cross-pose reuse of the same emission distinguish hypotheses?
estimand: Posterior probability of two candidate locations under their exact finite observation-sequence probability laws and equal prior weights
model: Four discrete observations. Independent Bernoulli(1/2) emissions at integer times -1 through 3, including pre-start emission. Candidate A gain 1 and source amplitude 1; B gain 2 and source amplitude 1/2, so scale is not an identifying cue. Sensor starts at zero and obeys y_t=(y_(t-1)+gas_(t-1))/2 with gas_-1 at sensor initialization zero. This toy sensor is NOT a claim of numerical FOPDT parity.
fixed_path_control: All samples at X: A delay 0, B delay 1. Complete sequence laws should coincide despite random emissions.
moving_path_control: Path X,Y,X,Y: A delays X=0,Y=1; B delays X=1,Y=0. Shared emission identities may generate different cross-pose observation laws despite equal one-time gas marginals.
naive_baseline: Independently reconstruct each one-time gas marginal, take their product, then apply the same sensor law. Compare the resulting observation law to exact shared-emission enumeration; do not merely compare unfiltered gas variances.
same_input_bayes: Exact observation-sequence likelihood with identical source nuisance distribution is the reference, not a method to claim superiority over.
metrics: Exact total variation distance between candidate observation laws and equal-prior optimal classification accuracy; use fractions, not Monte Carlo or a tuned numerical threshold.
predictions: Fixed-path total variation is zero. Moving-path total variation is positive only under the specified known delay map; the independent-marginal baseline loses that source contrast. The contrast is conditional and is not a novel algorithm or a universal identification proof.
scope: Pure algebra and exhaustive enumeration. No House simulation, new physical source worlds, banks, seed experiments, true source inputs, or algorithm takeover.
required_before_deployment: Independently justified source innovation family, source-conditioned transport delay law from allowed observations, initial-field/sensor treatment, and evidence beyond an ordinary correctly specified joint Bayesian model.
